content_descriptors.notes: Mythscroll contains optional criminal actions (e.g. robbing merchants), fantasy combat described through text, and may contain references to alcohol and/or tobacco consumption. Players may also encounter vague, magical substances such as herbs and mushrooms with effects like disorientation or hallucination. All content is text-based with no graphic visuals or voice acting.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core CPU, 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 1024 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 3000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 50 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Game may not run correctly on systems with outdated GPU drivers. Update to the latest drivers if you encounter visual issues.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with OpenGL 3.3+ support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 50 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Game is designed for widescreen displays and may appear letterboxed on 4:3 monitors.
